description: This file defines the PhpHash class implementing incremental hashing functionality using PHP's hash functions within the Aws namespace. It provides methods for updating, completing, and resetting hash computations with support for various algorithms and options.

classes.name: PhpHash
classes.description: A class implementing incremental hashing using PHP's hash functions, supporting various algorithms and options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new PhpHash object with a specified hashing algorithm and options.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Feeds data into the ongoing hash computation.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Finalizes the hash calculation and returns the hash, encoding in base64 if specified.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the hash context and hash value.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current hash context, creating a new one if necessary.
